question: Which is the longest river in the world?
solution:
Correct answer is__** Nile.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Nile River** is roughly **4,100 miles long** and was factually thought to be the** longest river in the world.**
 
• There is many of discussion surrounding this, however, for many **believe the Amazon River in South America might be longer.**
 
• The Nile River flows through** south to north through eastern Africa.**
 
• It starts in the** rivers that flow into Lake Victoria**, and empties into the **Mediterranean Sea **more than **6,600 kilometers (4,100 miles) **to the north, making it one of the longest river in the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​The **River Ganges **emerges in the western Himalayas and flows down over **northern India into Bangladesh, where it empties into the Bay of Bengal.**
 
• **The Amazon** is the significant river of South America and the largest drainage system in the world in terms of the volume of its flow and the** area of its basin.**
 
• **Yangtze** is the country's chief** waterway, **and its basin is China's great granary and contains nearly one-third of the **national population. **
